slot_order: SHA256(protocol + class + source_group_id + annotation_id); lexical annotation ID breaks ties
group_policy: Hash-ordered annotation queues by group; round-robin groups, one distinct annotation per group per round, structural geometry checks only
normal_order: SHA256(slot_id + normal_id); first same-canvas, hash-verified TRAIN normal; no quality screening
sample_seed_rule: Stage20A rule retained: first 64 bits SHA256(Plastic_Bomo_Generation_V2 + slot_id + str(bank_seed)); integer big-endian in [0,2**64-1]

geometry.mask: L-mode rectangle, floor(left/top), ceil(right/bottom), exclusive right/bottom
geometry.mask_semantics: white inpaint, black retain; weak bbox geometry NOT segmentation ground truth
geometry.output: paste generated 512 patch into the same full normal canvas at fixed crop origin; ignore padded pixels, no blending or quality selection
geometry.synthetic_labels: only frozen target bbox; background normal has no dataset-defined boxes

generator_training.budget_unit: 2000 successful optimizer updates per class; attempted updates and AMP skips recorded separately
generator_training.trainable_parameter_dtype: float32 master parameters; never FP16 optimizer gradients
generator_training.loss: unweighted ordinary denoising MSE; target determined by public base training scheduler prediction_type

prompts.flash: a photo of a sks flash defect
prompts.black: a photo of a sks black spot defect

generator_training.training_order: annotation IDs sorted; deterministic per-class permutation seed42 + zero-based epoch
generator_training.augmentation: none; deterministic geometric crop and hard rectangular mask
generator_training.normal_background_policy: no extra normal-only generator training; masked donor crop is the denoising condition; frozen TRAIN normals only at inference
generator_training.checkpoint_save_rule: final pipeline only after 2000 successful updates; no validation checkpoint selection
generator_training.final_checkpoint_rule: class final_step2000 pipeline; hash all components; refuse if successful updates !=2000

generation.pipeline: StableDiffusionInpaintPipeline; standard inpainting only; no magic/dynamic/task-guidance branches
generation.safety_checker: disabled for industrial images; no safety-based sample replacement
generation.generator_device: CPU torch.Generator per slot; freshly seeded; record before/after state hashes at future runtime
generation.output_encoding: lossless RGB PNG for final full canvas; no JPEG re-encoding
generation.checkpoint: same newly trained V2 class final_step2000 checkpoint across banks, hash bound before ANY sampling

detector.early_stopping: explicitly disabled in future trainer, not merely hidden by val=False
detector.final_eval_during_or_at_train_end: forbidden; override trainer final_eval automatic validation
detector.accumulation_rule: fixed 64 draws; reset each epoch, flush the 24-draw tail, normalize each accumulation group by actual draw count; warmup changes LR/momentum only, never accumulation; future trainer must enforce this schedule
detector.augmentation_rng: per draw fresh seed = first64bits SHA256(protocol + 'augmentation' + '42' + epoch + position); same across arms; no global RNG consumption coupling
detector.runtime_version_policy: actual SERVER_P0 installed package versions and trainer/default/loss/optimizer source hashes are frozen; no package upgrades during Stage20B
detector.unsupported_args_policy: stop; do not silently omit or substitute frozen hyperparameters

detector_weight_evidence: same public pretrained artifact hash as existing frozen pretrained initialization audit; not a trained detector checkpoint; GitHub ultralytics/assets v8.3.0 yolo11s.pt size19313732

raw_output_policy.structural_failure_consequence: stop formal comparison if any frozen slot fails; do not replace it or silently reduce 40/40

schedule.shuffle: sort roles by SHA256(protocol + str(42) + str(epoch) + role_id); lexical role breaks ties
schedule.optimizer_attempt_rule: positions 63,127,191,215 in each zero-based epoch; fixed accumulation64 and tail24; 600 scheduled attempts; AMP success counts may vary

base_public_reference.formats: exact FP32 safetensors files above only; no fp16/bin/sharded or fine-tuned substitutions
